evidence_spans: In a single-core setup, MRB-4 (MRB-DRAM with 4 row buffers) achieves an average IPC improvement of 29.7% over DDR4 as shown in Figure 2.
We evaluate the performance of MRB-DRAM using Ramulator [1].
CLM-MEM-0058.statement: MRB-DRAM with four SRBs per bank achieves a 29.7% average single-core performance improvement over conventional DDR4.

extra_quotes: We evaluate the performance of MRB-DRAM using Ramulator [1].
For energy calculations, we use DRAMspec [12] and DRAMPower5 [13].
